edits.before: - Vex Personal Space (Fear): matchup-defining — Shield + AoE fear that punishes dashes — never dash onto her while her passive glows. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Shocking Orb like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Personal Space is 16s at rank 1 and 12s maxed at 475 range — a shield plus AoE fear, so never step inside it while her passive glows. - Looming Darkness is a flat 12s at 800 range. - Guard your 13s Shocking Orb like a fifth summoner spell.

notes: Chart fully agrees across both layers and with the packet (Xerath all 7 rows) — no chart edits. Lint flagged five report[] entries; all five edits are pronoun-only lint fixes, not template rewrites, so the two-rewrite report cap is not spent. dosFull[0].d body is loosely matched to its title but was not lint-flagged and its content is kit-true; left alone. Missing interactions folded in: Vex fear interrupts Xerath R channel (spikes[1].text), W shield absorbs burst (dontsFull[2].d, breakdown.cooldowns). Note the site's 'Personal Space (Fear)' label conflates her W shield with the passive fear; the fear actually comes from Doom 'n Gloom empowering her next ability — kept the site convention in short labels but grounded new prose in the real split.
